replication.target_description: Study 2 general change-in-grades description and p. 6 locator do not uniquely identify a regression.

notes: Only assigned unfinished fields assessed; other fields are placeholders. PDF pages 5–6 visually inspected. Candidates include the first-year transition controlling entry grades (p. 5: β = −0.05, t = −0.95, p = .345; age/sex-adjusted β = −0.04, t = −0.81, p = .417); subsequent year 2/3/4 regressions (p. 6: β = 0.02/−0.04/−0.04); and first-year mindset-by-entry-grade interaction (p. 6: β = −0.03, t = −0.54, p = .592). Common final N candidate is retained only for parent field-scope review, not assigned with unresolved row-specific correspondence. 223 + 190 + 169 = 582 participants: final mutually exclusive fixed, mixed, and growth mindset groups in Fig. 3. Recruitment N = 586 is separate. Four students (two female and two male) with first-year numerical grades more than 5 SDs below the sample mean due to personal circumstances were removed from all analyses (p. 5 §5.2). No N inferred from degrees of freedom.
